DC_IRDA_DEVICE_GET_ADDRESS(3) Library Functions Manual DC_IRDA_DEVICE_GET_ADDRESS(3)

NAME

dc_irda_device_get_address — Get the address of the IrDA device.

LIBRARY

library “libdivecomputer”

SYNOPSIS

#include <libdivecomputer/irda.h>

unsigned int
dc_irda_device_get_address(dc_irda_device_t *device);

DESCRIPTION

Get the address of the IrDA device. Return value used for opening a IrDA device using dc_irda_open(3). Requires a valid irda device of type dc_irda_device_t which can be retrieved using dc_irda_iterator_new(3).

RETURN VALUES

Returns the IrDA address of given IrDA device

SEE ALSO

dc_irda_open(3), dc_irda_device_get_name(3).
